# List notes

Source: api/quillpost~3anotes/list-notes

# List notes

`GET /notes?notebook=\{notebook_id\}` returns the notes of one notebook.

# The inbox

Source: concepts/inbox

# The inbox

The inbox lists notes that are not yet in a notebook. Notes sync every minute, and on every save. Offline edits merge when you reconnect. A sync conflict keeps both copies.

![The inbox with three notes](screenshots/inbox/1.png)

:::note

A note stays in the inbox until you move it.

:::

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Title | The first line of the note |
| Updated | When it last changed |

# Quillpost team docs

Source: ./

# Quillpost team docs

Quillpost keeps your notes in notebooks and shares them with your team.

- [The inbox](concepts/inbox.md)
- [Create a note](tasks/create-a-note.md)
- [Share a notebook](tasks/share-a-notebook.md)
- [Keyboard shortcuts](reference/keyboard-shortcuts.md)
- [List notes (API)](api/quillpost~3anotes/list-notes.md)
- [Archive a notebook](tasks/archive-a-notebook.md)

See also the known issues page for what is being fixed.

# Keyboard shortcuts

Source: reference/keyboard-shortcuts

# Keyboard shortcuts

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| Ctrl+N | New note |
| Ctrl+S | Save |
| Ctrl+K | Search |

# Archive a notebook

Source: tasks/archive-a-notebook

# Archive a notebook

Open the notebook menu and press **Archive**.

# Create a note

Source: tasks/create-a-note

# Create a note

1. Press **New note**.
2. Type a title, then the body.
3. Press **Save**. The note is saved with the id `\{note_id\}` shown in the address bar.

![The new note form](screenshots/create/1.png)

To call the API, send the header `Authorization: Bearer <QUILLPOST_TOKEN>` where <QUILLPOST_TOKEN> is your own placeholder value.

```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <QUILLPOST_TOKEN>' https://quillpost.example.invalid/notes/{note_id}
```

# Share a notebook

Source: tasks/share-a-notebook

# Share a notebook

Open the notebook, press **Share**, and pick who can read or edit it.

Read [the inbox](../concepts/inbox.md) first if you have not.
